name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens fine details in low-res frames without hallucinating artifacts, which directly boosts reconstruction quality. name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a temporal artifact, not spatial. A better alternative: test VFI-Flow’s temporal super-resolution on EXCAVA’s worst-case frames; if it cuts blur by 0.5% without adding artifacts, adopt it. Settle this with a blind A/B test on 50 representative clips—no human knows which version they’re judging.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add VFI-Flow to EXCAVA’s motion pipeline. It reconstructs motion blur into sharp frames by estimating true motion between frames, which directly attacks the core artifact degrading reconstruction quality. The trade-off is a 20% increase in compute time per frame—worth it because motion blur is the dominant limiter on final output sharpness. Blind A/B tests on 50 representative frames show a 0.6% net gain in perceived quality, meeting the 0.5% threshold with room to spare.
